items.name: state-fips
items.title: State FIPS

items.name: map-palette
items.title: Map palette

items.name: map-bounds
items.title: Map bounds
items.description: A bounding box grown over GeoJSON geometry, for flying a map to a feature.

items.name: map-basemap
items.title: Basemap
items.description: OpenFreeMap's positron style, which needs no key.

items.name: state-districts

items.name: district-join

items.name: policy-filters
items.title: Policy filters

items.name: policy-imagery
items.title: Policy imagery
items.description: Which picture a jurisdiction, chamber or member gets, and which colour a party gets.

items.name: use-local
items.title: useLocal
items.description: State that survives a reload in localStorage, and reads correctly on the first server-rendered paint.

items.name: seals
items.title: Seals
items.description: A jurisdiction's flag chip, a chamber's seal, a member's portrait with its fallback, and a party dot.

items.name: directory-search
items.title: Directory search
items.description: The search field a directory is filtered with, clearable, on an input group.
